Reservation & Cancellation Policy :
  • Check-in time is 12.00 PM, Check-out time is 11.00 AM
  • Hotel Cancellation Policy: Free cancellation up to 24hrs before check-in. 3% payment gateway fees applicable In case of a no-show, 100% of the booking amount will be charged. Date modifications are subject to availability and may incur additional charges.
  • Check-in after 10 PM is not allowed
  • Refund Timeline: Refunds (if applicable) will be processed within 7–14 business days via the original mode of payment.
  • Early Check-Out: Guests who check out earlier than the booked dates may be charged for the remaining nights as per booking terms. For reservations of 2 or more rooms, cancellations made less than 1 days before check-in will incur 50% of the total booking amount.
